shared_elements: animal in profile with four legs (A) vs profile figures/signs including animals in B's sign repertoire
low-relief carving on a flat upright slab face
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief on a flat upright slab, and both include profile creatures, but that is the extent of the correspondence: A shows a small number of isolated, large, naturalistic quadrupeds (a bovid-like animal above a fox-like animal) floating on a plain field with no framing, while B is densely covered with rows of miniature script-like signs organised into ruled horizontal registers with seated human figures facing offering tables. There is no shared specific motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the compositional logic (sparse isolated animals vs registered text-and-figure panels) is entirely different.
